KeyboardLights supports the legacy Cloud Nine C989 with firmware 1.38.
Revised hardware with firmware 1.82 is incompatible.

## Did this work before?

## Screenshots or diagnostic logs (optional)

Attach screenshots or relevant diagnostic logs if they help explain the problem.
Diagnostic logging is off by default. The [macOS guide](https://github.com/pgoodcodeos/kblights/blob/HEAD/docs/macos.md#refresh-and-troubleshooting)
and [Linux guide](https://github.com/pgoodcodeos/kblights/blob/HEAD/docs/linux.md#files-and-troubleshooting)
explain how to enable it and where to find logs.

Before posting, remove personal paths, device identifiers, private profile content,
and credentials from screenshots and logs. Do not include raw keyboard captures
unless a maintainer requests them and you have reviewed their contents.
